parameters.query:
SELECT biz.business_id, biz.business_name, biz.provider_email 
FROM businesses biz 
WHERE biz.active = TRUE

=SELECT b.scheduled_start, s.name_en AS service_name, c.full_name AS customer_name, b.quote_min, b.quote_max 
FROM bookings b 
JOIN customers c ON b.customer_id = c.customer_id 
JOIN services s ON b.service_id = s.service_id 
WHERE b.business_id = '{{ $json["business_id"] }}' 
  AND b.status = 'confirmed' 
  AND b.scheduled_start >= (CURRENT_DATE + 1) 
  AND b.scheduled_start < (CURRENT_DATE + 2)
ORDER BY b.scheduled_start ASC
